{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique status values:", df['status'].unique())
print("Unique revenue values (top 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])
print("Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99'", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
